Aftergraph should assume its favorite idea already exists until the evidence says otherwise.

Use this thread to challenge the novelty, naming, mechanisms, or claimed gaps behind SPEC-001, MISSION-Bench, Agentic Institution Engineering, evidence-gated completion, attenuated authority, durable mission execution, and related work.

High-value submissions include:
- papers and preprints,
- patents and claim language,
- standards, RFCs, and specifications,
- source code, tests, issues, PRs, and release history,
- commercial systems with materially equivalent observable behavior,
- older multi-agent, distributed-systems, control-theory, security, workflow, or institutional-computing work.

Please identify the exact overlap: object model, invariant, mechanism, protocol binding, behavior, or empirical result. "This sounds like X" is a useful lead; "section Y / claim Z implements the same semantics" is much better.

The strongest acceptable outcome is not protecting Aftergraph's terminology. It is narrowing, correcting, or rejecting a claim when prior art warrants it.
